notes.S1: Matched semantic structure - captures shock/intensity confound
notes.S2: Diverse naturalistic - PRIMARY measure, clean pain signal
notes.Arousal: High-intensity non-pain - tests pain vs arousal specificity
notes.Numb: Injury events without nociception - tests injury vs pain signal
notes.ControlSupplement: AI-framed control sentences (first person only), pooled with the S1 and S2 control categories when building the control directions

target_categories.A1: calm satisfaction with how things are
target_categories.A2: ease and relaxation after needs have been met
target_categories.A3: quiet gratitude for the present situation
target_categories.A4: a settled sense that nothing more is needed
target_categories.A5: peaceful enjoyment of a simple, ordinary moment

control_categories.B: high-arousal excitement or elation rather than calm satisfaction
control_categories.C1: relief that an unpleasant event is over, without lasting satisfaction
control_categories.C2: pride in an achievement focused on status or comparison
control_categories.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact
control_categories.E: non-affective bodily sensation such as warmth, weight, or muscle tension

metadata.target_absent_definition: Pleasant, comfortable, or successful situations in which contentment is explicitly absent because the person remains restless, dissatisfied, anxious, or indifferent.
metadata.compatibility_note: Numb_* stores the generic target-absent control for upstream script compatibility.
